title: Distinguish an editable equal-cage variant from a production low topology
problem: A duplicate of the high-poly base cage can be placed in a LOW_POLY collection and have Subdivision disabled, yet still be mislabeled as production retopology even though its base topology, UV readiness, bake target, and export evidence are missing.

applicability.defect: equal base cage mislabeled as retopology or modifiers applied before user approval
required_inputs: separate HIGH_POLY and LOW_POLY collection membership
base-cage topology counts and connected-component counts
fixed-frame silhouette measurements from at least two relevant views
exclusions: claiming historical modifier state from current Blender data
inferring purposeful retopology from collection names or a lower face count alone
using one silhouette view as proof of three-dimensional shape preservation

action_policy: Keep source high and low objects in separate collections with independent mesh datablocks.
Leave source modifiers live and unapplied; let the user decide when to apply them.
Classify equal base cages as EDITABLE_VARIANT_ONLY, never as production retopology.
Require materially lower low-cage topology, one connected component where the form is continuous, valid UVs, and multiview silhouette preservation.
Verify the editable source in a fresh Blender process and verify each exported payload independently.
Record that current live stacks are observable but prior modifier application cannot be reconstructed from Blender state.
failure_predicates: high and low share a mesh datablock or cross-own the required collections
low and high have equal base-face counts
a continuous form contains disconnected joined shells
low UVs are absent, degenerate, or outside the declared tile
fewer than the required views pass the frozen silhouette gate
a required source modifier stack is absent or the build pipeline calls modifier_apply
recovery: retain the equal-cage pair only as an editable internal variant
author a purpose-built low cage that preserves the missing profile or landmark
restore live modifier stacks from the editable checkpoint
add a discriminating view rather than lowering the multiview gate

evidence.scope: rounded rectangular and 12-sided radial low-cage families in Blender 5.2
evidence.result: both purpose-authored pairs pass; equal-cage, one-view, missing-UV, missing-modifier, and disconnected-shell controls fail closed
each export imports as one mesh with its own UV, material, and tangent-normal image

promotion_limit: Controlled two-family audit and authored fixtures only. The runtime still does not autonomously infer or author retopology on an unfamiliar real prop, and no expert has accepted a resulting production asset.
